    Covering a module by indecomposable projectives #

    For a list of vectors mᵢ ∈ eᵢ M, the sum ⊕ A eᵢ maps to M by a ↦ a mᵢ on the i-th summand (sumMap). The sum is Euler-projective (eulerProj_sumProj), and taking bases of all eᵢ M gives a surjection (exists_cover).
